items.title: Roy Palmer Interview, 1955-09-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I used to see, Buck Johnson and I used to record him... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, well, that's a good way to it.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, I used to use, I used oil too, but oil, it kept us buying so expensive in a way. You had to be buying but 25 cents a bottle, but you would use it, yeah, see. What I did, I used kitty-kill sale. Kitty-kill sale. Just take the kitty-kill sale and throw it on your slide all the way down, grease your slides good, and after you grease your slides with this kitty-kill sale, you put a little kerosene on it, and that slide will fly. And it doesn't evaporate as fast? No, it doesn't evaporate as fast. But they…
I used to see, Buck Johnson and I used to record him, sometimes he would run water through his trombone under a faucet.
Yeah, well, that's a good way to it. It keeps the instrument moist, see, yeah.
